answer: Milestone bond: each identity locks a 60-credit bond anchored to a milestone ledger and earns by clearing milestones. Agents may wander, but each milestone needs a receipt, and a comet sweep replays 10% per epoch. Faking the k-th identity costs a 60-credit bond plus 18 in fees, so 1,000 fakes cost 78,000 against 40,000 in rewards. A rented-milestone ring fails: receipts bind to one key and one epoch. An honest agent pays once and keeps its bond.
